name: RIPARIAN HEART
source:
Charlie sent you a message asking if you were awake. It's half past eleven. Yeah, what's up, you reply. Your last conversation was just over a year ago.

You have something you've been wanting to tell Charlie. Tonight is the night, you tell yourself, as if you haven't told yourself that before, more than once.

[From [url=https://skyshard.itch.io/riparian-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
查理给你发来一条消息，问你睡了没有。现在是十一点半。“没睡，怎么了？”你回复道。距离你们上一次聊天，已经过去一年多了。

你心里一直有句话想对查理说。就是今晚了，你对自己说道——仿佛此前你还没对自己这样说过不止一次似的。

[摘自[url=https://skyshard.itch.io/riparian-heart]itch.io[/url]]
